# Every Pokémon pairing: compact Punnett-square atlas

**Snapshot:** 24 September 2026  
**Scope:** National Pokédex species nos. 0001–1025 (Bulbasaur through Pecharunt)  
**Result:** 525,825 separate Punnett squares, including self-pairings

## How to read every diagram

The exhaustive atlas below uses a lossless serialized diagram so that the report fits the 8 MiB delivery limit. Each line is one separate Punnett square, not a range or summary. Look up each four-digit parent ID in the genetic-code register, then expand `AAAA×BBBB` with this fixed square:

```text
             Parent BBBB
             first   second
Parent AAAA first   first·first   second·first
            second  first·second  second·second
```

More precisely, if AAAA's registered code is **ab** and BBBB's is **cd**, its line expands to:

| × | c | d |
|---|---|---|
| **a** | ac | ad |
| **b** | bc | bd |

Superscripts remain attached to their letter when concatenated. Thus every ledger line plus the register is a complete 2×2 diagram with four explicit, deterministic cells; no biological dominance, probability, or phenotype is asserted.

Examples:

**0001×0025 — Bulbasaur (BU) × Pikachu (PI)**

| × | P | I |
|---|---|---|
| **B** | BP | BI |
| **U** | UP | UI |

**0025×0393 — Pikachu (PI) × Piplup (P²I²)**

| × | P² | I² |
|---|---|---|
| **P** | PP² | PI² |
| **I** | IP² | II² |

## Evidence and method

**Facts supported by sources.** The official Pokémon Pokédex identifies species by National Pokédex number; for example, its live pages label [Bulbasaur as #0001](https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokedex/bulbasaur), [Flittle as #0955](https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokedex/flittle), and [Pecharunt as #1025](https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokedex/pecharunt). The official Pokémon site also says there are “over 1,000 Pokémon” ([Discover Pokémon Together: Lechonk](https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokemon-news/discover-pokemon-together-lechonk), 31 March 2023). The complete English-name transcription used here is PokeAPI's `pokemon_species_names.csv` at repository revision [`2b9ea590fcc62a1bce2534835e9d5d1b234a2976`](https://github.com/PokeAPI/pokeapi/blob/2b9ea590fcc62a1bce2534835e9d5d1b234a2976/data/v2/csv/pokemon_species_names.csv); PokeAPI is a secondary source, so the official numbered endpoint pages above are the authority and the CSV is the reproducible transcription aid.

**Task-supplied assumptions (not real Pokémon biology).** Every listed species can cross with every other; evolved species are distinct; a genetic code comes from the first two letters; repeated pairs receive increasing exponents on both letters. The report follows those premises even where the games' breeding mechanics differ.

**Implementation inferences.** “Combination” is treated as unordered, so A×B and B×A are one combination, while A×A is included. This yields 1,025×1,026÷2 = **525,825** squares. Duplicate numbering follows ascending National Pokédex number except that the prompt's explicit example controls the `PI` group: Pikachu is `PI`, Piplup is `P²I²`, and the other `PI` species continue at exponent 3 in Pokédex order. “Letters” means the first two alphabetic characters, ignoring spaces, punctuation, gender symbols, and hyphens; capitalization is normalized to uppercase. The first holder of a letter pair has no visible exponent (equivalent to exponent 1); later holders use ², ³, and so on. Forms, regional forms, Mega Evolutions, Gigantamax forms, and other alternate forms are not separate species because they do not have distinct National Pokédex numbers.

**Uncertainty and unanswered questions.** The prompt does not say whether crosses are ordered, whether self-crosses count, how punctuation should behave, or whether alternate forms count. The choices above make the atlas finite and auditable. If “possible combination” meant ordered crosses, there would instead be 1,050,625 diagrams; because reversing parents only transposes the four modeled outcomes, this report avoids that duplication. The roster is a dated snapshot and will need regeneration if new National Pokédex species are officially added.
